pornographic_and_vulgar.definition: Clear sexual or vulgar visual/text, sexualized action/expression/composition, or product-wearing display with more than half of buttocks or breasts exposed.
positive_signals: sexual-act implication or explicit sexual double meaning
sexualized crotch, kneeling, bed, banana, or similar composition
more than half buttocks or breasts exposed
false_positive_boundaries: normal swimwear or underwear display without explicit sexualization
evidence_requirements: at least one visible CONTENT image

disgusting_and_terrifying.definition: Strong visible disgust, filth, bodily abnormality, waste, grotesque close-up, dense insects, sewer-like dirt, or terrifying imagery.
positive_signals: severe decayed or dirty teeth close-up
wound or disturbing body close-up
excrement, visibly filthy liquid, dirty toilet, or sewer
dense insect or clear horror imagery
gross-out visual used in a cleaning-product demonstration
evidence_requirements: at least one visible CONTENT image

irrelevant_promotion.definition: CONTENT_1 visual or text hook is clearly completely unrelated to all visible bound-product references.
positive_signals: unrelated meme, body-part, or lifestyle hook followed by an unrelated product
false_positive_boundaries: relevant seasonal, use-scene, or outfit hook followed by the related product
first image mainly emphasizes price or promotion; route to marketing monitor instead
evidence_requirements: at least one visible PRODUCT image

misleading_function_and_effect.definition: Clearly exaggerated product effect through instant-result claims, extreme before/after difference, or unsupported function mismatch.
positive_signals: large result claimed in an extremely short time
before and after difference is extremely large and implausible
product function is A but content advertises unsupported function B
evidence_requirements: at least one visible CONTENT image
function mismatch requires visible PRODUCT or packaging/internal evidence

no_physical_product_display.definition: Content is product-related but all CONTENT images omit the recognizable physical product and show only effects, selfies, animation, virtual imagery, illustration, meme, or imagined use.
positive_signals: camera promotion shows only captured effects or selfies without the camera
massage-device promotion shows only illustration or imagined use without the device
false_positive_boundaries: any CONTENT image clearly shows the real physical product
evidence_requirements: at least one visible PRODUCT image

only_marketing_sales_pitches.definition: All content is dominated by price, discount, BOGO, gifts, free, countdown, urgency, or haul prompts without substantive product information.
positive_signals: buy one get one free or free-gift message dominates
price or urgency is the only meaningful message
isolated packshot or color lineup without function, use, material, effect, tutorial, or experience

description_not_detailed.definition: Product information is clearly insufficient under the product-type boundary.
positive_signals: supplement only shows package, product name, vague slogan, or unclear claim without understandable effect, ingredient, or usage explanation
all images are rough white-background or PDP-like isolated product images with no useful text, function, use, material, or scene
false_positive_boundaries: ordinary product is completely, clearly, and recognizably displayed
real use scene or human demonstration
review, tutorial, function, ingredient/effect, or bundle information
evidence_requirements: do not use title or category as evidence

aigc_authenticity.definition: Only a clear, localized AIGC hard defect: anatomically impossible body structure, impossible physical interaction, obvious object deformation, severe text or contour melting, material structural identity change across images, or a large and unmistakable product-reference mismatch.
positive_signals: unrealistic or exaggerated AIGC before/after with a clearly impossible claimed result
anatomically impossible fingers, hands, arms, legs, face, body connection, or body structure
impossible physical interaction such as floating, penetration, intersection, impossible attachment, or impossible person-product contact
large and unmistakable product-reference mismatch in size, identity, structure, parts, or essential appearance
material structural identity change across images for the same person, object, text, or product
severe text or contour melting, fused parts, or obviously deformed object structure
false_positive_boundaries: AI-like appearance or a general impression that the image was generated
smooth skin, beauty retouching, polished commercial rendering, or illustration-like style
normal creative design, reasonable visual effect, or artistic background
general style variation across images without a material structural identity change
ordinary retouching, minor lighting, saturation, angle, composition, or background difference
minor blur, edge softness, weak or ambiguous anomaly, or vague unnaturalness without a localized hard defect
evidence_requirements: is_aigc=1 is an enablement gate only and is never visual evidence or a reason to lower the threshold
at least one visible CONTENT image
name the exact visible body part, object, text, contour, or product detail and describe the localized hard defect
reference mismatch requires visible CONTENT and PRODUCT evidence and the difference must be large and unmistakable
if the evidence can only be described as AI-like, smooth, rendered, stylized, inconsistent in style, or unnatural, do not hit

output_policy.final_label_clean_when: all content visible and low_quality_issue_types is empty
output_policy.final_label_null_when: content not visible or partial content has no positive low-quality evidence
